TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Enable Passenger Shuttle Tweaks
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: This entire section is disabled by default for compatibility sake mostly, some shuttle related tweaks function regardless of if they've been changed (any changing a radius for example) so this allows them all to be skipped over without any potential for conflicts if you prefer another shuttle tweak mod.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Max Launch Distance
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The maximum distance the shuttle can travel in tiles.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Mass Capacity
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The mass capacity on the shuttle.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Fuel Capacity
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The fuel capacity on the shuttle.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Fuel Cost Per Tile
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The fuel cost for each tile distance traveled.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Launch Cooldown Ticks
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The ticks (60 per second) before the shuttle can launch again. Setting to 0 will effectively disable the cooldown.
